AutoSculpt 3D

From dream to reality

From a 3D model to a faceted sheet-metal sculpture: numbered pieces, bends and slots, DXF for laser cutting, mockup for the client, quote and assembly guide. Also metalwork made to measure and 2D CAD for the laser.

The app is installed in the Applications folder. The 3D models are made by AutoSculpt Studio, a separate free program.
